data.name: Basefall
data.detailed_description:
Basefall is a competitive multiplayer real-time strategy game featuring intense 1v1 and 2v2 lane-based battles where every match evolves as you play.

Spawn units. Unlock spells. Draft powerful upgrades mid-battle.

Destroy enemy towers and breach the base to win.

There are no turns. No downtime.

Only momentum, adaptation, and smart decisions under pressure.

Lane-Based Tactical Warfare

Battle across multiple lanes defended by towers.

To reach the enemy base, you must first break their defenses — but every push creates vulnerability elsewhere.

Control space. Apply pressure. Force mistakes.

2v2 Team Battles

Coordinate with a teammate in strategic 2v2 matches across three lanes.

Each player is assigned a defensive tower.

If your tower falls, your population is reduced — shifting the balance of power and forcing your team to adapt.

Support your ally. Defend your lane. Collapse together for the win.

Mid-Match Drafting & Progression

You don’t start fully equipped.

  • Begin with a single unlocked unit

  • Earn XP through combat and tower damage

  • Unlock additional units, wards, and spells during battle

  • Choose from randomized upgrade options

Every match becomes a new strategic puzzle.

Dynamic Upgrade Shop & Synergies

At key moments, you choose powerful upgrades that can redefine your entire build:

  • Stack burn, lifesteal, shields, slows, and damage buffs

  • Empower specific unit types

  • Create unexpected synergies

  • Adapt your strategy to counter your opponent

No fixed builds. No scripted metas.

Every match evolves differently.

Game Modes:

Competitive 1v1

Fast-paced head-to-head battles where smart decisions beat brute force.

2v2 Team Mode

Strategic coordination, shared pressure, and shifting population control across three lanes.

Dynasty Mode

Draft your army and spells mid-match through randomized choices.

Draft Mode

Build your loadout before battle and unlock it progressively using XP.

High Replayability

With evolving builds, randomized upgrades, and shifting battlefield pressure, no two matches play the same.

Master the lanes. Outdraft your opponents.

Destroy their base.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
